chunks: God has truly made the vision of His Apostle come true: You will surely enter the Holy Mosque in security if God please, without any fear, having shaved your heads and cut your hair. He knew what you did not know, and has vouchsafed you, apart from this, a victory near at hand.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the vision mentioned in Surah Al-Fath?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal as it validates the Prophet's initial dream of entering the Kaaba, which was initially met with skepticism by some companions, thereby affirming divine foreknowledge (Ilm al-Ghayb). The 'near victory' (Fath Qarib) refers to the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, which served as a strategic pause allowing Islam to spread, ultimately leading to the conquest of Mecca. This event underscores the transition from a period of concealment and treaty to open triumph, a theme frequently linked to the eventual rise of the Ahl al-Bayt.
